Comment: EventBridge rule to run the stock predictor pipeline weekdays at 9 AM Eastern

Rule.Name: stock-predictor-weekday-9am
Rule.Description: Run NASDAQ Day Trading Predictor pipeline weekdays at 9:00 AM ET

Notes.schedule: cron(0 13 ? * MON-FRI *) = 9 AM ET (during EDT, UTC-4). During EST (Nov-Mar), 9 AM ET = 2 PM UTC = cron(0 14 ? * MON-FRI *). Adjust if needed.
Notes.public_ip: ENABLED because we use the default VPC with public subnets and no NAT Gateway. The task needs internet access to call the yfinance API.
setup_steps: 1. Replace ACCOUNT_ID with your 12-digit AWS account ID
2. Replace REPLACE_WITH_SUBNET_* with your default VPC subnet IDs
3. Replace REPLACE_WITH_SECURITY_GROUP with your default VPC security group ID
4. Create the rule via AWS Console (EventBridge > Rules) or CLI
